column1: # Named tests of pending assertions (owner item 14b). Columns, tab separated:
#   group, assertion ids, test name or target:<test binary>, landed (yes|no), body patterns (ERE, joined by ~~; - for none)
# landed=no: the test must not exist yet (the check reports it pending); the commit that adds it flips the row to yes,
# and from then on the test must exist, match its body patterns and read ok in the gate's test log.
